title: Interior-product bound for the coefficient norm: |ι_vβ| ≤ |v|·|β| (parent (L2))
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let v ∈ ℝ^N = Euclid N and let β be a (k+1)-covector on ℝ^N (Covector (Euclid N) (k+1)). Let ι_vβ := β.curryLeft v be the interior product, the k-covector ι_vβ(w_1, …, w_k) = β(v, w_1, …, w_k). Then |ι_vβ| ≤ ‖v‖·|β|, where ‖v‖ is the Euclidean norm of v and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean norm of the values of α on the strictly increasing tuples of standard basis vectors.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β
